name: get-incident
description: Get an incident by its id, with status, severity, owner and timeline.

incident-id.description: Identifier of the incident, for example INC-1042.

name: list-open-incidents
description: List incidents that are still open, newest first.

severity.description: Only return incidents with this severity: sev1, sev2 or sev3.

name: create-incident
description: Open a new incident and page the on-call engineer of the affected service.

name: acknowledge-incident
description: Acknowledge an incident so the pager stops escalating it.

incident-id.description: Identifier of the incident to acknowledge.

name: resolve-incident
description: Mark an incident as resolved and record the resolution note.

name: add-incident-note
description: Append a timeline note to an incident.

name: list-deployments
description: List the deployments of a Kubernetes namespace with their ready replica counts.

name: get-deployment-status
description: Get the rollout status of a Kubernetes deployment.

name: restart-deployment
description: Restart a Kubernetes deployment and wait for the rollout to finish.

name: scale-deployment
description: Change the number of replicas of a Kubernetes deployment.

name: rollback-deployment
description: Roll a Kubernetes deployment back to its previous revision.

name: delete-namespace
description: Delete a Kubernetes namespace and every resource inside it.

name: list-pods
description: List the pods of a namespace with their phase and restart count.

name: get-pod-logs
description: Fetch the recent log lines of a pod container.

name: search-logs
description: Search application logs across services for a text pattern within a time window.

since.description: Start of the window, for example 1h.

name: get-error-rate
description: Get the HTTP 5xx error rate of a service over the last hour.

name: get-latency-percentiles
description: Get p50, p95 and p99 request latency of a service.

name: list-alerts
description: List monitoring alerts that are currently firing.

name: silence-alert
description: Silence a firing alert for a period of time.

duration.description: How long to silence it, for example 2h.

name: get-on-call
description: Find who is on call now for a team or service.

name: page-engineer
description: Send a page to a specific engineer.

name: override-on-call
description: Override the on-call schedule so another engineer takes the shift.

name: list-feature-flags
description: List feature flags and whether each is enabled per environment.

name: toggle-feature-flag
description: Turn a feature flag on or off in one environment.

name: get-customer
description: Get a customer account by email or id, with plan and status.

name: list-customer-invoices
description: List the invoices of a customer with amounts and payment status.

name: issue-refund
description: Refund all or part of a paid invoice.

name: cancel-subscription
description: Cancel a customer subscription at the end of the billing period.

name: create-ticket
description: Create a support ticket for a customer.

name: list-tickets
description: List open support tickets assigned to a team.

name: close-ticket
description: Close a support ticket with a final reply.

name: get-build-status
description: Get the status of the latest CI build of a repository branch.

name: retry-build
description: Retry a failed CI build.

name: list-releases
description: List recent releases of a service with their version and date.

name: create-release
description: Tag and publish a new release of a service.

name: rotate-api-key
description: Rotate the API key of a service account and revoke the old one.

name: list-access-grants
description: List who has access to a production system.

name: get-status-page
description: Get the current public status page entries.

name: post-status-update
description: Publish an update on the public status page.

name: run-database-backup
description: Start an on-demand backup of a production database.
